cards.body:
## Summary
Her window already mirrors her voice phase to Main 30 times a second (athena:face), and every face avatar speaks from it. The Bell, which is the default look, ignores it: pose.ts still says Main cannot know her voice is playing, so while she talks the dock and surface Bells show resting or working. Make the Bell a mirror of the same signal (talking-avatar face-signal-across-surfaces: one producer, every surface a mirror), add a speaking pose, and keep one presence derivation for both Bells.

## Description
- bell/voice-phase.ts: createVoicePhase(source: FaceSource, clock) reduces the mirrored FaceSignal stream to its phase only, notifies on change only (never per frame), and drops back to null after STALE_MS without a signal while listening or speaking, because the producer sends no rest frame when her window dies. useVoicePhase() wraps it over mainFaceSource(); outside the shell it stays null and nothing changes.
- bell/pose.ts: POSES gains 'speaking'; PoseInput gains optional voice: FacePhase | null. Order: a waiting card (asking), then hearing (held key or mirrored listening), then speaking, then work, then rest. Card-first stays as it is: the bell-vs-halo precedence is an open direction finding and this card does not decide it. The file's header premise is rewritten to cite the mirror.
- bell.css: a speaking pose on the existing variables (the house glow --accent, a quicker --pulse, ripples on), no new colour, no new keyframes, compositor only, off under Calm.
- Callers: Console.tsx and surface live.tsx pass the phase into poseOf; loop-current gets its POSE_SPEED row.

## Flow
- write cases 1-8 against pose.ts, voice-phase.ts, Bell and selectSurface; watch them fail
- voice-phase module and hook; pose member and order; bell.css rule
- wire Console and surface live; POSE_SPEED row
- ADR (the Bell mirrors her face phase) and a CHANGELOG line; perf:all

## Expected impact
With the default halo, a person who hears her talking sees the Bell speaking on the dock and on the surface, the same moment a face avatar would open its mouth. The halo, the face and the Bell stop telling three different stories about one voice, and a screen reader hears 'Athena, speaking'.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the default Bell shows her speaking while her voice plays, from the one mirrored signal
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass (2 guards green by design)
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - the acceptance cases
Result: better
Gate: none

cards.body:
## Summary
The surface is the home screen, and its five pictures are fixed: the Accounts glyph always wears a warning dot and the Chores glyph always wears a success dot, while the real 'needs you' is a small bullet after the name. The model already holds every number behind the lights. Let each glyph draw its own light's facts, so the person reads which depth wants them before reading a word.

## Description
Glyph gains facts: {attention, filled, of | null}. Per root: Apps inks one window per app switched on (up to 3) and leaves the rest as muted outlines; Accounts inks a ring per connected account and draws the warning dot only under attention; Chores draws the success mark only when something is tested; Voice draws its waves solid when her voice is ready, dashed and muted when not; Mind rings its core in the warning shape when the engine is not ready. of:null (counting, could not count) draws the plain drawing with no status mark at all. Status is carried by shape as well as hue. Light gains art: GlyphFacts, built in selectSurface from the numbers it already flattens into stat. The engine facet becomes one exported definition shared by glyphs.tsx and mind.tsx.

## Flow
- before: Accounts glyph shows a warning dot with every account healthy; Chores shows a green dot with nothing tested; a real attention is a ' •' after the name
- after: each picture shows its depth's state (2 of 5 apps inked, a warning only on the depth that needs you, dashed waves while voice is not set up); one glance picks the depth to dive into
- write cases 1-8, watch them fail; facts-aware drawings; Light.art in selectSurface; view passes it; CHANGELOG line; perf:surface

## Expected impact
The home screen stops showing a permanent false warning and a permanent false success, and the five pictures become a status board you can read at a glance. A whole class closes: no glyph can show a status its data does not back, pinned for every root and state.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - each depth glyph shows only the state its light's data backs
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass (cases 2 and 8 green by design)
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - the acceptance cases
Result: better
Gate: none
